name: TopSqill ITSM
install: npm ci --legacy-peer-deps && cd backend && npm ci && (npm run build || true)

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Vite + React dev server for the TopSqill SPA on http://localhost:8080 (proxies /api to the backend).

terminals.name: backend-build
terminals.description: TypeScript compiler in watch mode. Emits backend/dist incrementally on every change (tolerates the repo's pre-existing TS type-check warnings; does not wipe dist).

terminals.name: backend-run
terminals.command: cd backend && while true; do until [ -f dist/main.js ]; do sleep 1; done; node --watch dist/main.js; echo '[backend-run] process exited, restarting in 2s'; sleep 2; done
terminals.description: Runs the compiled NestJS API on http://localhost:3001/api, auto-restarts on backend/dist changes, and is supervised so it recovers from transient rebuilds. Requires the SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY secret.
